name: create-rr-stack

scripts.prepack: bun -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('template',{recursive:true,force:true}); await (await import('./scaffold.ts')).buildTemplate('..','template'); for (const f of ['LICENSE','README.md']) fs.copyFileSync('../'+f, f)"
scripts.postpack: bun -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const f of ['template','LICENSE','README.md']) fs.rmSync(f,{recursive:true,force:true})"

description: Scaffold a React Router + Rust (Axum) app that is typed from the database to the screen.
